messages:
Maya (sales): quick sync re: Zenith POC. Client wants long-doc summarization, RAG Q&A with citations, and snippet reranking for search UI. Need acceptance criteria + model plan.
Diego (eng): noted. Main constraints: 30k token docs, EU data residency, and mobile snippet latency target ~150-200ms p50.
Lena (infra): they want Private in eu-west-1, KMS/HSM, and no public egress for retrieval endpoints. Air-gapped option adds ~2 weeks.
Priyanka (security): will handle questionnaire. Need DPI, retention, and logging reqs from sales.
Maya (sales): proposed acceptance criteria draft:
- Summaries: manual pass rate >= 90% on sample set + ROUGE-L >= 0.58
- QA: citation precision >= 0.85, exact-answer accuracy >= 0.80 on client eval set
- Rerank: NDCG@5 lift >= 15% and p50 snippet latency < 200ms on Dedicated
- Security: Private EU deployment, KMS + questionnaire signed
Diego (eng): model plan suggestion:
- A: 32k-context LLM (quantized) for single-pass summaries and structured extraction (function-calls)
- B: 8k LLM + retrieve->embed->rerank pipeline for Q&A + snippet ranking (cheaper, lower hallucination)
- Reranker: small cross-encoder, run on Dedicated lane for low latency
Diego (eng): function schema example we will test:
```json
{"function":"extract_contract_fields","args_schema":{"contract_id":"string","effective_date":"string","party":"string","summary":"string"}}
```
Lena (infra): action: confirm EU private deployment timeline and cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Priyanka (security): action: I'll return questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow; need list of data flows from sales.
Maya (sales): action items: 1) provide expected monthly token volume (client) for pricing Hosted vs Dedicated 2) eng to prepare prompt bank + baseline outputs 3) infra to confirm timeline/costs 4) security to fill questionnaire.
Eval Bot: created POC workspace: https://git.redwood/poc/zenith and pushed initial eval harness.
Maya (sales): recommend we try retrieve+rerank first for QA, reserve 32k-run for summary acceptance only to save cost. I'll send this to the customer and ask for volumes. :thumbsup:
